The Hon'Ble Sri Justice Cheekati Manavendranath Roy
 Criminal Petition No.250 of 2022
Order:

-
This criminal petition under Section 482 of the Code of Criminal Procedure, 1973, is filed seeking quash of F.I.R. in Crime No.235 of 2019 of old Guntur Police Station, Guntur Urban District,
registered for the offences punishable under Sections 272, 273, 318 of the Indian Penal code, 1860 and Section 57(1) and 58 of the Food Safety Standards Act, 2006.

entities.text: Guntur Police Station, Guntur Urban District
entities.label: ORG

sentences.text:
2. Heard learned counsel for petitioners and the learned Additional Public Prosecutor for the 2nd respondent-State.
3.

This is a covered matter in view of the earlier common orders passed by this Court in Criminal Petition Nos.5421 of 2019 and batch and Criminal Petition Nos.2966 of 2021 and batch, whereby this Court has quashed several F.I.Rs registered for the similar offences based on identical facts.

Therefore, the petitioners, who are similarly placed, are also entitled for quash of the F.I.R.
registered against them.

5. Resultantly, in view of the aforesaid earlier common orders of this Court and for the reasons stated therein, this Criminal Petition is allowed and the aforesaid F.I.R. registered against the petitioners, is hereby quashed.
Miscellaneous Petitions, if any pending, in this Criminal Petition, shall stand closed.
JUSTICE CHEEKATI MANAVENDRANATH ROY Date : 25.01.2022 ikn
